literal: Spying on spy without knowing let one employ; together three [spies'] words agreeing, [it] will be confirmed.
translation: Let a ruler employ spies to watch other spies without their knowing each other; when the reports of three such independent spies agree, the information may be accepted as true.
modern: ஒரு ஒற்றனை மற்றொரு ஒற்றன் அறியாதவாறு உளவு பார்க்க ஆள வேண்டும்; அவ்வாறு தனித்தனியே உளவு பார்த்த மூன்று ஒற்றர்களின் செய்திகளும் ஒன்றுபட்டால் மட்டுமே அதை உண்மை என்று தெளிந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the method of verifying intelligence gathered by spies. The ruler should employ spies to spy on other spies without them being aware of each other. To ensure the reliability of the information, the ruler must compare the reports of three independent spies. Only when the words of all three spies agree should the information be trusted and acted upon. This system of triple-verification prevents false reports and ensures the security of the state.
